_comment: Single source of truth for the areas-served bands. Edit this file, commit, and scripts/areas.mjs rewrites every band on the site. `slug` means the city has a page at /areas/<slug>/ and gets linked; omit it for cities we serve but have no page for yet (they render as plain text, and become links automatically once the page exists). `featured` picks the shorter homepage list. Order here is the order they render, roughly Eastside -> north -> Seattle -> south -> peninsula.
